programs = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u065/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path = programs / 'task-c0bd55fe.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = next(c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 2)
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            distance = abs(c - center)
            if distance == r:
                out[r][c] = 2
            elif distance < r and (c - center - r) % 4 == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
